values.note: Camping is limited to 14 days in any 30 consecutive days. A first night's deposit is charged when booking. Check-in after 2 p.m., check-out 12 p.m.

note: Stutsman County campground by Jamestown Reservoir, a Bureau of Reclamation lake, 2 miles north of Jamestown on Highway 20: a wooded loop east of the park road, with four sleeping cabins, a swimming beach, fishing piers, boat ramps, a marina and a fish-cleaning station. An island near the campground is open for day use. --Claude
summary: County pages + Campspot: county-run (not a concession), $30 RV (+$2 Campspot fee per stay), 51 RV sites (stored 48) max 40 ft, 3 tent, 4 cabins; showers, dump; 14-in-30 limit; no seasonal program anywhere (all sites sold by the night). Not waterfront stands (sites ~200 m+ from the reservoir across the park road). Pin ~380 m off (on the road by the boat ramps); phone 701-252-1183 -> 701-368-1365.
